verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Marker GitHub claim that it converts files "in all languages". That is a first-party statement of multilingual parsing, but it gives no detail on CJK or right-to-left scripts and no evidence of fidelity parity with English. Missing for 10: explicit CJK support documentation, right-to-left script handling (bidi ordering, layout), multilingual accuracy benchmarks showing parity with English, independent or hands-on corroboration on non-English documents.

support.subject: As a developer, non-English documents — including CJK and right-to-left scripts — parse with the same fidelity as English

citations.quote: Converts PDF, image, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, HTML, EPUB files in all languages
